LHX.sentence: L3Harris ticked up a little, and the interesting thing about it is that it earns thinner profits than the bigger defense contractors — which is exactly why it looks cheap and why there's room to catch up.

ASML.sentence: ASML edged higher again, which is business as usual for the only company on earth making the machines that print the most advanced computer chips.

LIN.sentence: Linde barely moved this week — industrial gas demand is steady, they keep nudging prices up a little, and there's no drama to report.

MSFT.sentence: Microsoft has had a remarkably strong run, far outpacing similar companies, and the AI cloud story keeps humming along — it's up so much lately that it's simply looking a bit stretched.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher was roughly flat, but biotech funding is thawing again, and since that money eventually turns into lab-equipment orders, it's a quietly encouraging backdrop for them.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge is barely moving — its pipelines keep collecting steady tolls and paying a nice dividend, but it isn't cheap enough right now to be a bargain.

NOW.sentence: ServiceNow has fallen a long way from its high even though corporate customers keep signing up for its workflow and AI tools — the drop looks steep for a company still growing this fast.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore rose nicely and is actually doing better than pure copper miners, which suggests investors are giving credit to its huge commodity-trading arm on top of the mining.

RDDT.sentence: Reddit slipped again even though its advertising sales jumped 61% from a year ago — the market's worry is simply whether Google will keep sending as many visitors its way, since a big chunk arrive through Google searches.

KOF.sentence: This Mexican Coca-Cola bottler drifted up, and the thing that matters most to it is the Mexican peso, which is sitting in normal, steady territory right now.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras edged up and is still paying a very generous dividend, and the whole question with it is simply whether high oil prices keep that payout going.

AMKBY.sentence: Maersk, the container-shipping giant, was flat this week, and its shares are actually priced below what its fleet of ships is worth — which gives it a cushion on the downside.

MA.sentence: Mastercard slipped a touch, but it's unusually cheap compared to Visa right now given that it's the faster-growing of the two — people keep tapping their cards more every day.

ISRG.sentence: The da Vinci surgical robot company was flat but has been sold off lately more than similar medical-device makers — and there's no sign hospitals are actually doing fewer procedures, so it looks like a mood, not a real problem.
